submitted.rationale: Of the three measured points, Fe0.63Sb0.37 had the highest EQE (0.033%). EQE rose steadily from the Sb-rich end toward the Fe-rich end: 17 gave -0.002%, 13 gave 0.005% and 9 gave 0.033%. This matches Fe-rich rutile FeSbO4 or a hematite mixture doing better than Sb-rich films.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.005%, which is about 6x lower than index 9.
Measured EQE was slightly negative, so there is no useful photoresponse.

rejected.hypothesis: Even more Fe-rich compositions (indices 0-8) might be better
rejected.reason: The trend suggests this, but the merit budget ran out before any of them could be measured.
